descriptionChirho: To mend or repair something broken (such as fishing nets) or to restore a person who has gone astray to their proper condition.
To prepare or make something ready for its intended purpose, often with the implication of divine arrangement.
To bring to completion, equip fully, or perfect someone in spiritual maturity or moral character, often used of God's work in believers.
To frame or fashion something into existence, used of God creating or founding the visible world by his word.
